purpose: Prevent a Paita-context same-name Quebrada Vichayito label from being bound to the Los Organos/Talara Quebrada Vichayito child without a reproducible coordinate-level and hydrologic crosswalk.

talara_identity_anchor.institution: Municipalidad Provincial de Talara / CENEPRED SIGRID
talara_identity_anchor.bounded_claim: The official provincial plan names Quebrada Vichayito among dry or intermittent ravines in Talara hydrographic context.

paita_same_name_source.institution: Instituto Geofisico del Peru / CENEPRED SIGRID
paita_same_name_source.document: Inspeccion Geodinamica en los A.H. Vista al Mar, Cerro Lloron y Playa Cangrejos (Distrito y Provincia de Paita - Region Piura)
paita_same_name_source.bounded_claim: A Paita-context official geodynamic mapping source contains a same-name Quebrada Vichayito cartographic label in the broader Paita coastal-ravine context; that label is not by itself evidence that the feature is the Los Organos/Talara Quebrada Vichayito child.

required_before_any_crosswalk: exact source geometry or georeferenced line/polygon for the Paita-labelled feature with provenance
exact or reproducible geometry for the Los Organos/Talara Quebrada Vichayito child
coordinate-level comparison of continuity, separation and drainage direction
hydrologic crosswalk using outlet and receiving-water context rather than name coincidence
independent review that no event, threshold or negative label was transferred between provinces
forbidden: select a Quebrada Vichayito geometry by name alone
reuse any Paita Quebrada Vichayito geometry for Los Organos/Talara without a coordinate-level hydrologic crosswalk
treat a map label as a verified activation event
infer an outlet from territorial proximity
use absence of a dated local event as a negative control
create approximate geometry for the Talara child to resolve the ambiguity
merge Paita and Talara Vichayito identities until continuity is reproducibly demonstrated
next_gate: Acquire reproducible coordinates or vector geometry for both same-name features and adjudicate hydrologic continuity/separation before any Talara Vichayito geometry, outlet or event binding is allowed.
